inputs.name: cds_jwt_iss
inputs.label: CRD JWT Issuer
inputs.description:
Value of the `iss` claim that will be sent in the JWT used to authorize the CRD client's hook
              request sent as the Bearer token in the `Authorization` header.
              This value will be used to associate incoming requests with this test
              session and any requests that use a different `iss` value will not be recognized.

inputs.name: cds_jwk_set
inputs.label: CRD JSON Web Key Set (JWKS)
inputs.description: The CRD client's JWK Set containing its public key. May be either a publicly accessible URL containing the JWKS, or the raw JWKS. These tests may be run without this input, but it is required for the tests to pass.

inputs.name: complete_prefetch_service_organization_id
inputs.label: Complete Prefetch Service Organization id
inputs.description: The FHIR Organization id associated with Inferno's simulated complete prefetch CRD server. This Organization must be referenced as the payer on Coverages in hook requests made to services described by the `http://localhost:4567/custom/crd_client_v221/cds-services` discovery endpoint. These tests may be run without this input, but it is required for the tests to pass.

inputs.name: subset_prefetch_service_organization_id
inputs.label: Subset Prefetch Service Organization id
inputs.description: The FHIR Organization id associated with Inferno's simulated subset prefetch CRD server. This Organization must be referenced as the payer on Coverages in hook requests made to services described by the `http://localhost:4567/custom/crd_client_v221/prefetch-subset/cds-services` discovery endpoint. These tests may be run without this input, but it is required for the tests to pass.

inputs.name: cds_jwt_iss
inputs.label: CRD JWT Issuer
inputs.description: Value of the `iss` claim that must be present in the JWT used to authorize the CRD client's hook request sent as the Bearer token in the `Authorization` header. Run or re-run the "Registration" group to set or change this value.

inputs.name: complete_prefetch_service_organization_id
inputs.label: Complete Prefetch Service Organization id
inputs.description:
The FHIR Organization id associated with Inferno's simulated complete prefetch CRD server.
                Re-run the "Registration" group to provide this detail.

inputs.name: subset_prefetch_service_organization_id
inputs.label: Subset Prefetch Service Organization id
inputs.description:
The FHIR Organization id associated with Inferno's simulated subset prefetch CRD server.
                Re-run the "Registration" group to provide this detail.

inputs.name: appointment_book_response_approach
inputs.label: Response generation approach for appointment-book
inputs.description: Determines how Inferno will generate responses for appointment-book hook invocations.

inputs.name: appointment_book_selected_response_types
inputs.label: Response types to return from appointment-book hook requests
inputs.description:
Select the CRD response types that the simulated Inferno CRD server will [mock](https://github.com/inferno-framework/davinci-crd-test-kit/wiki/Controlling-Simulated-Responses#mocked-responses) when responding to hook invocations.
              Because CRD clients must support the [Coverage Information](https://hl7.org/fhir/us/davinci-crd/2.2.1/en/cards.html#coverage-information-response-type) response type on this primary hook, Inferno will always include a Coverage Information response, even if it is not selected.

inputs.name: appointment_book_custom_response_template
inputs.label: Custom response template for appointment-book hook requests
inputs.description: Provide a [custom response template](https://github.com/inferno-framework/davinci-crd-test-kit/wiki/Controlling-Simulated-Responses#tester-directed-custom-responses) in JSON form for Inferno to use when responding to hook invocations.

inputs.name: cds_jwt_iss
inputs.label: CRD JWT Issuer
inputs.description: Value of the `iss` claim that must be present in the JWT used to authorize the CRD client's hook request sent as the Bearer token in the `Authorization` header. Run or re-run the "Registration" group to set or change this value.

inputs.name: complete_prefetch_service_organization_id
inputs.label: Complete Prefetch Service Organization id
inputs.description: The FHIR Organization id associated with Inferno's simulated complete prefetch CRD server. This Organization must be referenced as the payer on Coverages in hook requests made to services described by the `http://localhost:4567/custom/crd_client_v221/cds-services` discovery endpoint. These tests may be run without this input, but it is required for the tests to pass. Re-run the "Registration" group to provide this detail.

inputs.name: subset_prefetch_service_organization_id
inputs.label: Subset Prefetch Service Organization id
inputs.description: The FHIR Organization id associated with Inferno's simulated subset prefetch CRD server. This Organization must be referenced as the payer on Coverages in hook requests made to services described by the `http://localhost:4567/custom/crd_client_v221/prefetch-subset/cds-services` discovery endpoint. These tests may be run without this input, but it is required for the tests to pass. Re-run the "Registration" group to provide this detail.

inputs.name: cds_jwk_set
inputs.label: CRD JSON Web Key Set (JWKS)
inputs.description:
The CRD client's registered JWK Set, provided during the "Registration" group, containing

            JSON. Run or re-run the "Registration" group to set or change this value.

inputs.name: complete_prefetch_service_organization_id
inputs.label: Complete Prefetch Service Organization id
inputs.description: The FHIR Organization id associated with Inferno's simulated complete prefetch CRD server. inputs.name: cds_jwt_iss
inputs.label: CRD JWT Issuer
inputs.description: Value of the `iss` claim that must be present in the JWT used to authorize the CRD client's hook request sent as the Bearer token in the `Authorization` header. Run or re-run the "Registration" group to set or change this value.

inputs.name: complete_prefetch_service_organization_id
inputs.label: Complete Prefetch Service Organization id
inputs.description: The FHIR Organization id associated with Inferno's simulated complete prefetch CRD server. This Organization must be referenced as the payer on Coverages in hook requests made to services described by the `http://localhost:4567/custom/crd_client_v221/cds-services` discovery endpoint. These tests may be run without this input, but it is required for the tests to pass. Re-run the "Registration" group to provide this detail.

inputs.name: subset_prefetch_service_organization_id
inputs.label: Subset Prefetch Service Organization id
inputs.description: The FHIR Organization id associated with Inferno's simulated subset prefetch CRD server. These tests may be run without this input, but it is required for the tests to pass. Re-run the "Registration" group to provide this detail.

inputs.label: CRD JSON Web Key Set (JWKS)
inputs.description:

            JSON. Run or re-run the "Registration" group to set or change this value.

This Organization must be referenced as the payer on Coverages in hook requests made to services described by the `http://localhost:4567/custom/crd_client_v221/cds-services` discovery endpoint. These tests may be run without this input, but it is required for the tests to pass. Re-run the "Registration" group to provide this detail.

inputs.name: subset_prefetch_service_organization_id
inputs.label: Subset Prefetch Service Organization id
inputs.description: The FHIR Organization id associated with Inferno's simulated subset prefetch CRD server. This Organization must be referenced as the payer on Coverages in hook requests made to services described by the `http://localhost:4567/custom/crd_client_v221/prefetch-subset/cds-services` discovery endpoint. These tests may be run without this input, but it is required for the tests to pass. Re-run the "Registration" group to provide this detail.

inputs.name: cds_jwt_iss
inputs.label: CRD JWT Issuer
inputs.description: Value of the `iss` claim that must be present in the JWT used to authorize the CRD client's hook request sent as the Bearer token in the `Authorization` header. Run or re-run the "Registration" group to set or change this value.

inputs.name: cds_jwk_set
inputs.label: CRD JSON Web Key Set (JWKS)
inputs.description:
The CRD client's registered JWK Set, provided during the "Registration" group, containing
            its public key. Used only when a request was received with a JWT without the `jku`
            header. May be either a publicly accessible URL containing the JWKS, or the raw JWKS
            JSON. Run or re-run the "Registration" group to set or change this value.

inputs.name: order_sign_response_approach
inputs.label: Response generation approach for order-sign
inputs.description: Determines how Inferno will generate responses for order-sign hook invocations.

inputs.name: order_sign_selected_response_types
inputs.label: Response types to return from order-sign hook requests
inputs.description:
Select the CRD response types that the simulated Inferno CRD server will [mock](https://github.com/inferno-framework/davinci-crd-test-kit/wiki/Controlling-Simulated-Responses#mocked-responses) when responding to hook invocations.

inputs.name: cds_jwt_iss
inputs.label: CRD JWT Issuer
inputs.description: Value of the `iss` claim that must be present in the JWT used to authorize the CRD client's hook request sent as the Bearer token in the `Authorization` header. Run or re-run the "Registration" group to set or change this value.

inputs.name: complete_prefetch_service_organization_id
inputs.label: Complete Prefetch Service Organization id
inputs.description: The FHIR Organization id associated with Inferno's simulated complete prefetch CRD server. This Organization must be referenced as the payer on Coverages in hook requests made to services described by the `http://localhost:4567/custom/crd_client_v221/cds-services` discovery endpoint. These tests may be run without this input, but it is required for the tests to pass. Re-run the "Registration" group to provide this detail.

inputs.name: subset_prefetch_service_organization_id
inputs.label: Subset Prefetch Service Organization id
inputs.description: The FHIR Organization id associated with Inferno's simulated subset prefetch CRD server. This Organization must be referenced as the payer on Coverages in hook requests made to services described by the `http://localhost:4567/custom/crd_client_v221/prefetch-subset/cds-services` discovery endpoint. These tests may be run without this input, but it is required for the tests to pass. Re-run the "Registration" group to provide this detail.

inputs.name: cds_jwt_iss
inputs.label: CRD JWT Issuer
inputs.description: Value of the `iss` claim that must be present in the JWT used to authorize the CRD client's hook request sent as the Bearer token in the `Authorization` header. Run or re-run the "Registration" group to set or change this value.

inputs.name: cds_jwk_set
inputs.label: CRD JSON Web Key Set (JWKS)
inputs.description:
The CRD client's registered JWK Set, provided during the "Registration" group, containing
            its public key. Used only when a request was received with a JWT without the `jku`
            header. May be either a publicly accessible URL containing the JWKS, or the raw JWKS
            JSON. Run or re-run the "Registration" group to set or change this value.

inputs.name: order_dispatch_response_approach
inputs.label: Response generation approach for order-dispatch
inputs.description: Determines how Inferno will generate responses for order-dispatch hook invocations.

inputs.name: order_dispatch_selected_response_types
inputs.label: Response types to return from order-dispatch hook requests
inputs.description:
Select the CRD response types that the simulated Inferno CRD server will [mock](https://github.com/inferno-framework/davinci-crd-test-kit/wiki/Controlling-Simulated-Responses#mocked-responses) when responding to hook invocations.
              Because CRD clients must support the [Coverage Information](https://hl7.org/fhir/us/davinci-crd/2.2.1/en/cards.html#coverage-information-response-type) response type on this primary hook, Inferno will always include a Coverage Information response, even if it is not selected.

inputs.description:
Cross-invocation analysis considers every hook request made during the most recent execution
              of each group in this session. Select `Yes` to send more requests now so that features
              the earlier requests did not cover can be demonstrated. Otherwise select `No` to
              evaluate the requests already received, and every test in the "Additional Hook Invocations"
              group will pass without further requests. NOTE: if re-running this test, requests
              made during its previous execution runs will no longer be considered, even if `No`

inputs.label: Response types to return from all hook requests
inputs.description:

              hooks, for which CRD clients must support the [Coverage Information](https://hl7.org/fhir/us/davinci-crd/2.2.1/en/cards.html#coverage-information-response-type)
              response type, Inferno will always include a Coverage Information response even if it
              is not selected. If no types are selected, Inferno will mock and return an
              [Instructions](https://hl7.org/fhir/us/davinci-crd/2.2.1/en/cards.html#instructions-response-type)
              response on the other hooks.

              group will pass without further requests. NOTE: if re-running this test, requests
              made during its previous execution runs will no longer be considered, even if `No`
              is selected.

inputs.name: cross_hooks_response_approach
inputs.label: Response generation approach for all hooks
inputs.description: Determines how Inferno will generate responses for all hook invocations.

inputs.name: cross_hooks_selected_response_types
inputs.label: Response types to return from all hook requests
inputs.description:
Select the CRD response types that the simulated Inferno CRD server will [mock](https://github.com/inferno-framework/davinci-crd-test-kit/wiki/Controlling-Simulated-Responses#mocked-responses) when responding to hook invocations.
              On the `appointment-book`, `order-sign`, and `order-dispatch`
              hooks, for which CRD clients must support the [Coverage Information](https://hl7.org/fhir/us/davinci-crd/2.2.1/en/cards.html#coverage-information-response-type)
              response type, Inferno will always include a Coverage Information response even if it
              is not selected. If no types are selected, Inferno will mock and return an
              [Instructions](https://hl7.org/fhir/us/davinci-crd/2.2.1/en/cards.html#instructions-response-type)
              response on the other hooks.

inputs.name: order_types_supported
inputs.label: Order types supported by the CRD client
inputs.description:
Select the resource types that the CRD client supports placing orders for.
              Inferno will expect those order types to be demonstrated within hook requests.
              By unchecking a resource type, the tester attests that the CRD client does
              not support placing orders for the kind of request represented by that FHIR resource type.

inputs.name: supporting_types_supported
inputs.label: Supporting resource types populated by the CRD client
inputs.description:
Select the resource types that the CRD client supports when representing information
              related to requests sent as a part of CRD. Inferno will expect those resource types to be
              demonstrated within hook requests. By unchecking a resource type, the tester attests
              that the CRD client does not support the information represented by the resource type
              or does not surface it to users. `Patient` and `Coverage` resource types are not listed
              but must be demonstrated because CRD clients are required to support them.

inputs.name: cds_jwt_iss
inputs.label: CRD JWT Issuer
inputs.description: Value of the `iss` claim that must be present in the JWT used to authorize the CRD client's hook request sent as the Bearer token in the `Authorization` header. Run or re-run the "Registration" group to set or change this value.

inputs.name: complete_prefetch_service_organization_id
inputs.label: Complete Prefetch Service Organization id
inputs.description:
The FHIR Organization id associated with Inferno's simulated complete prefetch CRD server.
                Re-run the "Registration" group to provide this detail.

inputs.name: subset_prefetch_service_organization_id
inputs.label: Subset Prefetch Service Organization id
inputs.description:
The FHIR Organization id associated with Inferno's simulated subset prefetch CRD server.
                Re-run the "Registration" group to provide this detail.

inputs.name: cds_jwk_set
inputs.label: CRD JSON Web Key Set (JWKS)
inputs.description:
The CRD client's registered JWK Set, provided during the "Registration" group, containing
            its public key. Used only when a request was received with a JWT without the `jku`
            header. May be either a publicly accessible URL containing the JWKS, or the raw JWKS
            JSON. Run or re-run the "Registration" group to set or change this value.
